title: Full Moon in Libra
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Libra / Aries axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates relationship, reciprocity, beauty, justice, consent, and the courage to choose cleanly through the Libra side of the axis, while the Sun in Aries asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: keeping peace at the expense of yourself, over-accommodating, or calling avoidance harmony
integration: creating balance that includes your needs too

twoWeekArc.teaching: The right people support your growth when you stop minimizing the beginning to protect everyone else.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Libra / Aries balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Venus kamea, pink or white candle, rose quartz, copper, peridot, roses, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Libra can be embodied without rejecting Aries.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Libra, and what balance with Aries is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Libra Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?

aries.intention: Release the stale pattern in partnerships, clients, commitments, and mirrors and integrate the Libra / Aries axis with more honesty.
